companyFieldUpdates.name: Pocahontas Parkway Operations, LLC
companyFieldUpdates.description: Pocahontas Parkway Operations, LLC operates the long-term tolled-road concession south of Richmond, Virginia. The manager-level platform includes the 8.8-mile Pocahontas Parkway, its James River crossing, tolling systems and the 1.58-mile Richmond Airport Connector; bridges, ramps, plazas and financing vehicles remain components rather than separate PortCos. Globalvia completed its acquisition on December 20, 2016 and currently reports a 68.14% stake. Northleaf joined as a direct co-investor in 2017 and remains active; its exact ownership percentage is not publicly disclosed. No later equity sale or signed pending transfer was identified through September 1, 2026.
